metadata.title: Langevin-type dynamics and hypocoercivity on $\mathrm{SE}(3)$
metadata.abstract:
We construct hypocoercive Kolmogorov-type operators on the Euclidean motion group $\mathrm{SE}(3)=\mathbb{R}^3times\mathrm{SO}(3)$ using ZXZ Euler angles and study their long-time behaviour using the abstract hypocoercivity method. The operator $L=S-A$ decomposes into a symmetric part $S$, corresponding to a degenerate diffusion on the rotation component $\mathrm{SO}(3)$, and an antisymmetric part $A$, which captures transport and torque effects induced by the Lie group structure. The associated invariant probability measure is $\mu_\Phi=\gamma_\Phi\otimes
u_3$, where $\gamma_\Phi$ is a probability measure on $\mathbb{R}^3$ with density $Z(\Phi)^{-1}e^{-\Phi}$ with respect to the Lebesgue measure, and $
u_3$ is the normalized Haar measure on $\mathrm{SO}(3)$. As a consequence, if $\Phi\in C^\infty(\mathbb{R}^3)$ is bounded from below, $\gamma_\Phi$ satisfies a Poincaré inequality with constant $\Lambda>0$, and there exists $c<\infty$ such that  egin{equation*} |
abla_\xi^2\Phi(\xi)| \leq c igl(1+|
abla_\xi\Phi(\xi)| igr), \quad \xi\in\mathbb{R}^3, \end{equation*} then the semigroup generated by the closure of $L$ converges exponentially fast to equilibrium in $L^2(\mathrm{SE}(3),\mu_\Phi)$.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: SE(3) 上的 Langevin 型 hypocoercivity
analysis.workSummary: 在欧氏运动群上构造只在旋转方向退化扩散、包含运输和力矩的 Kolmogorov 算子，以抽象 hypocoercivity 证明指定不变概率测度下的 L² 指数趋近平衡。
analysis.breakthrough: 将定量平衡理论用于耦合平移与旋转的运动群动力学。
analysis.limitations: 势函数光滑、有下界，权测度须满足 Poincaré 不等式，Hessian 另满足相对梯度增长界。
